text: Complete web-build numbers for the Focus/reload meter. Max is a hard constant 8*24 = 192 frames (8 s at 24 fps), NOT 48 + 6*SPD — the getBaseReload() value is stored and never read. It fills +1 per tick, so a full bar takes exactly 8 s. Per-slash drain is the weapon's slashusage (floor 48) scaled by stance: /2 in Light, x1 in Balanced and Reversed, x1.5 in Heavy and Dual. Switching stance costs a flat 48 frames on the web (android cuts to a third above half, else minus a sixth). The Focus skill sets reload to maxreload - 1. And a stance switch is refused outright while reload < maxreload/6 — that is the 'CANNOT CHANGE STANCE' label visible in the longplay.
